jobs:

        shell: bash

    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact original Core800 source
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1

          ref: 1a76a09d9cb8210cc2b76eda0c63a08bcd89d4ec
          path: core-source
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout exact closed two-boot case source
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        timeout-minutes: 3
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.source_sha }}
          path: case-source
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout exact original KSM637 VM source
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1

        with:
          ref: de21d6c25e0fbf5ac83c71965bae3ffa23390461
          path: vm-source
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout exact accepted generic16K kernel inputs
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        timeout-minutes: 3
        with:
          ref: 247123187cb1aceae5e61bc89f3c01dbf2986311
          path: kernel-inputs
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout exact seven accepted byte-identical native archives
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        timeout-minutes: 3
        with:
          ref: e410bd5d6b4318f114d7311a99a60f20bc8d2f4a
          path: core7-inputs
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout all original64 retained dependency inputs
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        timeout-minutes: 3

          path: core64-inputs
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Whole frozen source and actual first-run native proof before secrets or actors
        id: proof
        timeout-minutes: 4
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          printf '%s  %s\n' '@ENTRY_SHA@' "$CASE/entry.py" '@MANIFEST_SHA@' "$CASE/source-manifest.json" | sha256sum --check
          python3 -I -B "$CASE/entry.py" source --source "$CASE"
          python3 -I -B "$OWN/entry.py" source --source "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/core-source"
          python3 -I -B "$OWN/test_contract.py"
          python3 -I -B "$OWN/test_fixture.py"
          python3 -I -B "$OWN/assemble.py" --source-only
          python3 -I -B "$CASE/test_case.py"
          python3 -I -B "$CASE/test_protocol.py"
          python3 -I -B "$CASE/test_emission.py"
          python3 -I -B "$CASE/test_host.py"
          python3 -I -B "$CASE/test_route.py" --vm-source "$VMCASE"
          python3 -I -B "$CASE/test_sources.py" --core-source "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/core-source" --vm-source "$VMCASE" --kernel-carrier "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/kernel-inputs"
          mkdir -m 0700 "$PARENT"

      - name: Bounded disposable host QEMU prerequisite before native producer
        timeout-minutes: 5
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=10s 120s apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=0 update
          sudo timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=10s 120s apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=0 install --no-install-recommends -y qemu-system-arm
          /usr/bin/qemu-system-aarch64 --version
          /usr/bin/dpkg-query -W qemu-system-arm
      - name: Checkout complete exact original574 retained inputs
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        timeout-minutes: 3
        with:
          ref: ddc6ca5f3478f9c607f8fae52661c451ae0bf3ad
          path: native574-complete-public-inputs
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Prefill exact original policy caches before unchanged legacy CLIs
        timeout-minutes: 4
        run: >-
          python3 -I -B "$OWN/entry.py" prefill --source "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/core-source"
          --carrier "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/native574-complete-public-inputs" --temp "$RUNNER_TEMP"
          --receipt "$PARENT/legacy-prefill.json"
      - name: Prefetch exact32 original frozen574 archive files
        timeout-minutes: 4
        run: >-
          python3 -I -B "$DEPLOY/archive32.py" --policy "$DEPLOY/archive32-policy.json"
          --inputs "$BUNDLE/scripts/ci/maintained-desktop574-inputs.json" --cache "$RUNNER_TEMP/core-lifecycle-archive32"
      - name: Prefetch exact20 additional original frozen574 archive files
        timeout-minutes: 4
        run: >-
          python3 -I -B "$DEPLOY/archive20.py" --policy "$DEPLOY/archive20-policy.json"
          --inputs "$BUNDLE/scripts/ci/maintained-desktop574-inputs.json" --cache "$RUNNER_TEMP/core-lifecycle-archive20"
      - name: Prefetch exact8 additional original frozen574 archive files
        timeout-minutes: 4
        run: >-
          python3 -I -B "$DEPLOY/archive8.py" --policy "$DEPLOY/archive8-policy.json"
          --inputs "$BUNDLE/scripts/ci/maintained-desktop574-inputs.json" --cache "$RUNNER_TEMP/core-lifecycle-archive8"
      - name: Seed the six existing private input files using unchanged secrets
        timeout-minutes: 2
        env:
          CACHY_RETAINED_BUBBLEWRAP_V1_PACKAGE_01: ${{ secrets.CACHY_RETAINED_BUBBLEWRAP_V1_PACKAGE_01 }}
          CACHY_RETAINED_BUBBLEWRAP_V1_PACKAGE_02: ${{ secrets.CACHY_RETAINED_BUBBLEWRAP_V1_PACKAGE_02 }}
          CACHY_RETAINED_BUBBLEWRAP_V1_SIGNATURE_01: ${{ secrets.CACHY_RETAINED_BUBBLEWRAP_V1_SIGNATURE_01 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_SCHEMA: '1'
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_SOURCE_EPOCH: '1791748800'
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_JBIGKIT_01: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_JBIGKIT_01 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_JBIGKIT_02: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_JBIGKIT_02 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_JBIGKIT_SIG_01: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_JBIGKIT_SIG_01 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_01: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_01 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_02: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_02 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_03: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_03 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_04: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_04 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_05: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_05 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_06: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_06 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_07: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_07 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_08: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_08 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_09: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_09 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_10: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_10 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_11: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_11 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_12: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_12 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_13: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_13 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_14: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_14 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_15: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_15 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_SIG_01: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_SIG_01 }}
        run: >-
          python3 -I -B scripts/ci/maintained_desktop574.py seed
          --inputs scripts/ci/maintained-desktop574-inputs.json
          --output "$PARENT/base"
      - name: Checkout exact fourteen public input files
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        timeout-minutes: 3
        with:
          ref: 04a4a74e16e1e1bc939ea74791bf1f1bf7b46bbd
          path: retained-public-inputs
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Seed the exact public inputs without secrets
        timeout-minutes: 3
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git -C "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/retained-public-inputs" rev-parse HEAD)" = 04a4a74e16e1e1bc939ea74791bf1f1bf7b46bbd
          printf '%s  %s\n' 'a7857658af224984065e575f6ffed8308ea85027d46eace8bda146d9033e93b3' "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/retained-public-inputs/seed.py" 'a388c8c8ba8e06cb92fd2be598b86e433c4e403b6e71a0f15b1eaec381bb7300' "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/retained-public-inputs/index.json" | sha256sum --check
          env -i PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin HOME="$RUNNER_TEMP" LANG=C.UTF-8 TZ=UTC TMPDIR="$RUNNER_TEMP" python3 -I -B "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/retained-public-inputs/seed.py" --cache "$PARENT/base/context/deps"
      - name: Join original zero-request indexes and seed original80 then complete1148
        timeout-minutes: 4
        run: >-
          python3 -I -B "$OWN/entry.py" seed --source "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/core-source"
          --carrier "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/native574-complete-public-inputs" --temp "$RUNNER_TEMP"
          --base "$PARENT/base" --receipt "$PARENT/retained-custody.json"
      - name: Reuse unchanged owned574 native producer
        timeout-minutes: 40
        env:
          JOB_TOKEN: ${{ steps.proof.outputs.job_token }}
        run: >-
          timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=10s 2300s
          python3 -I -B scripts/ci/maintained_desktop574.py build
          --inputs scripts/ci/maintained-desktop574-inputs.json
          --output "$PARENT/base" --job-token "$JOB_TOKEN"
      - name: Original fresh574 current64 TEST assembly then two owned real-systemd boots
        timeout-minutes: 241
        run: >-
          python3 -I -B "$CASE/entry.py" execute --source "$CASE" --core-source "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/core-source" --vm-source "$VMCASE" --core7 "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/core7-inputs" --core64 "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/core64-inputs" --kernel-carrier "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/kernel-inputs"
          --proof "$PARENT/source-proof.json" --base "$PARENT/base" --output "$PARENT/owner"
      - name: Ordered all consumers and owned data then unchanged producer cleanup
        if: always() && steps.proof.outcome == 'success'
        timeout-minutes: 20
        run: >-
          python3 -I -B "$CASE/entry.py" cleanup --source "$CASE" --core-source "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/core-source" --vm-source "$VMCASE" --core7 "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/core7-inputs" --core64 "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/core64-inputs" --kernel-carrier "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/kernel-inputs"
          --proof "$PARENT/source-proof.json" --base "$PARENT/base" --output "$PARENT/owner"
          --receipt "$PARENT/ordered-cleanup.json"
      - name: Closed complete Core7 evidence gate
        if: always() && steps.proof.outcome == 'success'
        timeout-minutes: 4
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          result=0
          python3 -I -B "$CASE/entry.py" retain --source "$CASE" --core-source "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/core-source" --vm-source "$VMCASE" --core7 "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/core7-inputs" --core64 "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/core64-inputs" --kernel-carrier "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/kernel-inputs" --proof "$PARENT/source-proof.json" --base "$PARENT/base" --output "$PARENT/owner" --receipt "$PARENT/ordered-cleanup.json" --public "$PARENT/public" || result=$?

          path: ${{ github.workspace }}/core7-systemd-vm-parent/transport/

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Acquire only five pinned public archives/signatures as data; never install."""
import argparse
import concurrent.futures
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
lock = json.loads((HERE/'inputs.lock.json').read_text())
assert len(lock['packages']) == 5
assert sum(p['size'] + p['signature_size'] for p in lock['packages']) < 1024**2
parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
parser.add_argument('--source-root', type=Path, required=True)
parser.add_argument('--cache', type=Path, required=True)
parser.add_argument('--keydir', type=Path, required=True)
parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path, required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
source = args.source_root.resolve(strict=True)
for relative, sha256 in {
    'scripts/port/authenticate.py': '241cd67370eb593bdf948a25788f006ecf470c645ba5d198bc9c318119ebfe10',
    'scripts/port/preview.py': 'd737c51474e05cc2c4db2e87fc021f50328eea7744983dd4076d44751fce7383',
    'scripts/ci/native_arm.py': 'a8b6ed8971a38089a4499dcec605477c4e48d7a47c3de485d205f6a44678b898',
}.items():
    assert hashlib.sha256((source/relative).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == sha256, 'tested source helper pin mismatch'
sys.path.insert(0, str(source/'scripts/port'))
import authenticate as auth

cache = args.cache.resolve()
assert not args.cache.is_symlink()
args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
cache.mkdir(mode=0o700, exist_ok=True)
assert not cache.is_symlink() and cache.stat().st_uid == os.getuid() and cache.stat().st_mode & 0o077 == 0
keys = args.keydir
for item in lock['keyring_files']:
    src = keys/item['filename']
    assert src.is_file() and src.stat().st_size == item['size'] and auth.native.sha(src) == item['sha256']
    target = cache/item['filename']
    assert not target.is_symlink()
    if target.exists():
        assert target.is_file() and target.read_bytes() == src.read_bytes()
    else:
        target.write_bytes(src.read_bytes())

def fetch(item):
    auth.fetch(item, cache)
    auth.fetch(auth.native.signature_item(item), cache)

with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as pool:
    list(pool.map(fetch, lock['packages']))
observations = args.output/'observations'
observations.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
rows = []
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='gpg-', dir=args.output) as tmp:
    gpg = ['/usr/bin/gpg', '--batch', '--no-options', '--homedir', tmp,
           '--no-auto-key-retrieve', '--no-autostart']
    imported = subprocess.run(gpg+['--import',str(cache/'archlinuxarm.gpg')], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
    assert imported.returncode == 0
    for item in lock['packages']:
        result = subprocess.run(gpg+['--status-fd','1','--verify',str(cache/(item['filename']+'.sig')),
                                    str(cache/item['filename'])], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
        auth.status(result)
        observed = auth.observe(cache/item['filename'], item)
        auth.native.save(observations/(item['name']+'.json'), observed)
        rows.append({'name':item['name'], 'version':item['version'], 'archive_sha256':item['sha256'],
                     'signature_sha256':item['signature_sha256'], 'size':item['size'],
                     'signature_status':'PASS: pinned official signer, archive/hash/size, PKGINFO',
                     'package_execution':'NOT RUN'})
auth.native.save(args.output/'acquisition.json', {'status':'PASS', 'packages':rows,
    'installation':'NOT RUN', 'public_only_gpg_home_removed':True,
    'signer_fingerprint':lock['signer_fingerprint'],
    'scope':'pinned upstream binary archives read as data; not corresponding-source/license closure'})
print('PASS: five pinned archives/signatures authenticated; package execution NOT RUN')

jobs:
  native:
    if: github.repository == 'Gabriel-Kahen/cachy-asahi' && github.event.repository.private == false
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    timeout-minutes: 350
    env:
      SOURCE_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
      WORKFLOW_SHA: ${{ github.workflow_sha }}
      SOURCE_COMMIT: a79c4ca92486854f9edb639cd970d2c90fda4b12
      INPUTS_SHA256: ${{ inputs.inputs_sha256 }}
      RECIPES_SHA256: ${{ inputs.recipes_sha256 }}
      RETRY_MODE: ${{ inputs.mode }}
      REQUESTED_INTEGRATION_SHA256: ${{ inputs.integration_sha256 }}
    steps:
      - name: Capture the source-owned350 minute job clock before every checkout
        timeout-minutes: 1
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 -I -B - <<'PYJOB'
          import hashlib,json,os,re,stat,time
          from pathlib import Path
          source=os.environ['GITHUB_SHA'];run=os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ID'];ref=os.environ['GITHUB_REF_NAME'];root=Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP'])
          assert re.fullmatch('[0-9a-f]{40}',source) and source==os.environ['SOURCE_SHA']==os.environ['WORKFLOW_SHA'] and re.fullmatch('[1-9][0-9]{0,19}',run) and re.fullmatch('codex/[a-z0-9-]+',ref) and os.environ['GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT']=='1'
          assert root.is_absolute() and root==root.resolve() and root.stat().st_uid==os.getuid() and not root.stat().st_mode&0o022
          started=time.monotonic();value=dict(schema=1,status='SOURCE_OWNED_CORE622_JOB_CLOCK_DATA_ONLY',identity=dict(source=source,ref=ref,run=int(run),attempt=1),nonce=hashlib.sha256(('current607-core622:'+source+':'+run).encode()).hexdigest()[:32],runtime_temp=str(root),started=started,deadline=started+21000,global_seconds=21000,reserved_seconds=dict(cleanup=240,retention=360,upload=300,grace=120))
          fd=os.open(root/'core622-job-clock.json',os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_NOFOLLOW|os.O_CLOEXEC,0o600)
          with os.fdopen(fd,'wb')as out:out.write((json.dumps(value,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\n').encode())
          PYJOB
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        timeout-minutes: 1
        with:
          ref: a79c4ca92486854f9edb639cd970d2c90fda4b12
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout the current fresh607 source child
        timeout-minutes: 1
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: b9976eea34eaed4b6e56af3be21d4d652fa971d6
          path: fresh607-code
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Exact separate622 source role core622-code
        timeout-minutes: 1
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          path: core622-code
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Exact separate622 source role core51-parent
        timeout-minutes: 1
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: 11b3cfb59663e42b34247facb9f30f042e891444
          path: core51-parent
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Exact separate622 source role core-source
        timeout-minutes: 1
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: 1a76a09d9cb8210cc2b76eda0c63a08bcd89d4ec
          path: core-source
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Exact separate622 source role vm-source
        timeout-minutes: 1
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: de21d6c25e0fbf5ac83c71965bae3ffa23390461
          path: vm-source
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Exact separate622 source role kernel-inputs
        timeout-minutes: 1
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: 247123187cb1aceae5e61bc89f3c01dbf2986311
          path: kernel-inputs
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Exact separate622 source role core7-inputs
        timeout-minutes: 1
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: e410bd5d6b4318f114d7311a99a60f20bc8d2f4a
          path: core7-inputs
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Exact separate622 source role core64-inputs
        timeout-minutes: 1
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: 7dfce898755583bbf8081aae04d8b8579f66be58
          path: core64-inputs
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Exact separate622 source role core622-core-record
        timeout-minutes: 1
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: 6e29f427fe273042ebaeca24d00326173888e95d
          path: core622-core-record
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Exact separate622 source role core622-fresh-record
        timeout-minutes: 1
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: 5a0789405ded23f759f4a3aa545cf737c4ec3bde
          path: core622-fresh-record
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Whole622 and original Core source controls before secrets or actors
        timeout-minutes: 3
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 -I -B "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/core622-code/run622.py" --source-preflight
          python3 -I -B "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/core-source/scripts/ci/core-native-lifecycle/entry.py" source --source "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/core-source"
          python3 -I -B "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/core-source/scripts/ci/core-native-lifecycle/test_contract.py"
          python3 -I -B "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/core-source/scripts/ci/core-native-lifecycle/test_fixture.py"
          python3 -I -B "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/core-source/scripts/ci/core-native-lifecycle/assemble.py" --source-only
          python3 -I -B "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/core51-parent/test_case.py"
          python3 -I -B "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/core51-parent/test_protocol.py"
          python3 -I -B "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/core51-parent/test_emission.py"
          python3 -I -B "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/core51-parent/test_host.py"
          python3 -I -B "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/core51-parent/test_route.py" --vm-source "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/vm-source"
          python3 -I -B "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/core51-parent/test_sources.py" --core-source "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/core-source" --vm-source "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/vm-source" --kernel-carrier "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/kernel-inputs"
          CORE622_CORE_SOURCE="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/core-source" CORE622_PARENT51="$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/core51-parent" python3 -I -B "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/core622-code/test_desktop622.py"
          python3 -I -B "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/core622-code/test_bridge622.py" --core-source "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/core-source" --vm-source "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/vm-source" --fresh607-source "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fresh607-code"
      - name: Held generic QEMU prerequisite for separately owned twoBoot622
        timeout-minutes: 5
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=10s 120s apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=0 update
          sudo timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=10s 120s apt-get -o Acquire::Retries=0 install --no-install-recommends -y qemu-system-arm
          /usr/bin/qemu-system-aarch64 --version
      - name: Authenticate current child before original library gates or native actors
        timeout-minutes: 2
        shell: bash
        env:
          LIBRARY_SOURCE: ${{ inputs.source }}
          CURRENT_CHILD_SOURCE: b9976eea34eaed4b6e56af3be21d4d652fa971d6
          CURRENT_WORKFLOW_SHA: b9976eea34eaed4b6e56af3be21d4d652fa971d6
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$LIBRARY_SOURCE" = bd0cf1891083d011b70edab10501c317d3720b78
          [[ "$CURRENT_CHILD_SOURCE" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]
          test "$CURRENT_CHILD_SOURCE" = "$CURRENT_WORKFLOW_SHA"
          test "$(git -C fresh607-code rev-parse HEAD)" = "$CURRENT_CHILD_SOURCE"
          test "$(sha256sum fresh607-code/source-manifest.json | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" = 89f28bd898d4491abe05f346b91d9567620d747b4a0c22fb64fe8b09878fc3cd
          python3 -I -B fresh607-code/implementation/run.py --source-preflight
      - name: Checkout issued Root accepted Six853 DATA record
        timeout-minutes: 1
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: eea3f3022c9214deacc60c92dfca13704420756b
          path: fresh607-record
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Materialize pinned historical input DATA without acquisition or acceptance replay
        timeout-minutes: 2
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 -I -B fresh607-code/implementation/stage_inputs.py --record "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fresh607-record" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/fresh607-input-data"
      - name: Checkout the separate expanded604 installer implementation
        timeout-minutes: 1
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ inputs.source }}
          path: expanded604-installer
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Require original library source and accepted native604 inputs before native work
        timeout-minutes: 2
        id: installer_policy
        shell: bash
        env:
          IMPLEMENTATION_SOURCE: ${{ inputs.source }}
          WORKFLOW_SOURCE: ${{ inputs.source }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(sha256sum expanded604-installer/scripts/ci/expanded604-apps6-public-pair-installer/ci.py | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" = e9db1d8d2abebe363db9e6ebfc11e7ff2cfb3de19cf053efa7606219058666a3
          test "$(sha256sum expanded604-installer/scripts/ci/expanded604-apps6-public-pair-installer/source-manifest.json | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" = 5f4dbc150a5f8ca6a85843b783e7b5472251a4b0761e75e65f7d82b165a7b629
          python3 -B expanded604-installer/scripts/ci/expanded604-apps6-public-pair-installer/gate.py \
            --implementation "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/expanded604-installer" --source "$IMPLEMENTATION_SOURCE" \
            --workflow-sha "$WORKFLOW_SOURCE" --preflight
      - name: Checkout the fixed old helper and setup3 baseline
        timeout-minutes: 1
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: b6b17e5f6b322f160f7eeb22c8a01380a3c854cd
          path: expanded604-legacy
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout unchanged original seven-pair input root
        timeout-minutes: 1
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: 7fee76d68e5fd75437d8b49aaaced8376d2215cd
          path: expanded604-seven
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout the Root-bound accepted eight-pair input root
        timeout-minutes: 1
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ steps.installer_policy.outputs.eight_source }}
          path: expanded604-eight
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout fixed public management source
        timeout-minutes: 1
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ steps.installer_policy.outputs.management_source }}
          path: expanded604-management-source
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout fixed public setup source
        timeout-minutes: 1
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ steps.installer_policy.outputs.setup_source }}
          path: expanded604-setup-source
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout fixed public welcome source
        timeout-minutes: 1
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ steps.installer_policy.outputs.welcome_source }}
          path: expanded604-welcome-source
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout fixed public fresh600 decisions
        timeout-minutes: 1
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ steps.installer_policy.outputs.fresh600_decisions }}
          path: expanded604-fresh600-decisions
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout fixed public native604 decisions
        timeout-minutes: 1
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ steps.installer_policy.outputs.native604_decisions }}
          path: expanded604-native604-decisions
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout exact apps6_source
        timeout-minutes: 1
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ steps.installer_policy.outputs.apps6_source }}
          path: apps6-inputs
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Checkout exact apps6_authority_source
        timeout-minutes: 1
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
        with:
          ref: ${{ steps.installer_policy.outputs.apps6_authority_source }}
          path: apps6-authority
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Retrieve only the six original pinned audio inputs
        timeout-minutes: 2
        id: audio_inputs
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 -B expanded604-legacy/scripts/ci/full-development-composition/retrieve_audio.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/audio-archives"
      - name: Verify actual Root decisions and accepted archive bytes before secrets
        timeout-minutes: 2
        shell: bash
        env:
          IMPLEMENTATION_SOURCE: ${{ inputs.source }}
          WORKFLOW_SOURCE: ${{ inputs.source }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          python3 -B expanded604-installer/scripts/ci/expanded604-apps6-public-pair-installer/gate.py \
            --implementation "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/expanded604-installer" --source "$IMPLEMENTATION_SOURCE" \
            --workflow-sha "$WORKFLOW_SOURCE" --legacy-source "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/expanded604-legacy" \
            --seven-source "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/expanded604-seven" --eight-source "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/expanded604-eight" \
            --management-source "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/expanded604-management-source/payload" \
            --setup-source "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/expanded604-setup-source" \
            --welcome-source "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/expanded604-welcome-source/payload" \
            --fresh600-decisions "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/expanded604-fresh600-decisions" \
            --native604-decisions "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/expanded604-native604-decisions" \
            --apps6-source "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/apps6-inputs/payload" --apps6-authority-source "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/apps6-authority" \
            --audio-inputs "$RUNNER_TEMP/audio-archives"
      - name: Run unchanged installer controls and focused604 controls without actors
        timeout-minutes: 3
        shell: bash
        env:
          EXPANDED600_LEGACY_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}/expanded604-legacy
          EXPANDED600_SEVEN_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}/expanded604-seven
          CURRENT604_INSTALLER_SOURCE: ${{ github.workspace }}/expanded604-installer
          PUBLIC_PAIR_INSTALLER_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}/expanded604-installer
          PUBLIC_PAIR_COMPOSITION_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}/expanded604-installer
          EXPANDED604_SOURCE: ${{ github.workspace }}/expanded604-installer
          EXPANDED604_LEGACY_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}/expanded604-legacy
          EXPANDED604_FRESH600_DECISION: ${{ github.workspace }}/expanded604-fresh600-decisions/payload/fresh600.json
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sudo -n -- python3 -I -B "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/fresh607-code/implementation/source_controls.py" --workspace "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
      - name: Seed the six frozen private cache objects before native work
        timeout-minutes: 2
        if: inputs.mode == 'build'
        shell: bash
        env:
          CACHY_RETAINED_BUBBLEWRAP_V1_PACKAGE_01: ${{ secrets.CACHY_RETAINED_BUBBLEWRAP_V1_PACKAGE_01 }}
          CACHY_RETAINED_BUBBLEWRAP_V1_PACKAGE_02: ${{ secrets.CACHY_RETAINED_BUBBLEWRAP_V1_PACKAGE_02 }}
          CACHY_RETAINED_BUBBLEWRAP_V1_SIGNATURE_01: ${{ secrets.CACHY_RETAINED_BUBBLEWRAP_V1_SIGNATURE_01 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_SCHEMA: '1'
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_SOURCE_EPOCH: '1791748800'
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_JBIGKIT_01: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_JBIGKIT_01 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_JBIGKIT_02: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_JBIGKIT_02 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_JBIGKIT_SIG_01: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_JBIGKIT_SIG_01 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_01: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_01 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_02: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_02 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_03: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_03 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_04: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_04 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_05: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_05 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_06: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_06 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_07: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_07 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_08: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_08 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_09: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_09 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_10: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_10 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_11: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_11 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_12: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_12 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_13: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_13 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_14: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_14 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_15: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_15 }}
          CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_SIG_01: ${{ secrets.CACHY_OLD_FOUR_LIBTIFF_SIG_01 }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$SOURCE_COMMIT"
          test "$INPUTS_SHA256" = beca39e04e125a0fa72dedab2dd772e048655d80c36c216a031df0a0c3852e8f
          timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=5s 75s python3 -B - <<'PYSEED'
          import hashlib
          import os
          from pathlib import Path
          import sys
          sys.path.insert(0, 'scripts/ci')
          from old_four_seed import (OLD_FOUR_PRIVATE_ROWS, RETAINED_BUBBLEWRAP_PRIVATE_ROWS,
                                     seed_current_build_cache)
          pin = 'beca39e04e125a0fa72dedab2dd772e048655d80c36c216a031df0a0c3852e8f'
          if hashlib.sha256(Path('scripts/ci/inputs.lock.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest() != pin:
              raise SystemExit('private-cache-input-binding-refused')
          names = {'CACHY_OLD_FOUR_' + f'{tag}_{i:02d}'
                   for _, _, _, tag, count in OLD_FOUR_PRIVATE_ROWS for i in range(1, count + 1)}
          retained = {'CACHY_RETAINED_BUBBLEWRAP_V1_' + f'{tag}_{i:02d}'
                      for _, _, _, tag, sizes in RETAINED_BUBBLEWRAP_PRIVATE_ROWS
                      for i in range(1, len(sizes) + 1)}
          names |= retained
          if len(names) != 22 or len(retained) != 3 or not all(os.environ.get(name) for name in names):
              raise SystemExit('private-cache-required-secrets-missing')
          cache = Path(os.environ['RUNNER_TEMP']) / 'alarm-cache'
          cache.mkdir(mode=0o700)
          keep = names | {'CACHY_OLD_FOUR_SCHEMA', 'CACHY_OLD_FOUR_SOURCE_EPOCH'}
          for name in tuple(os.environ):
              if name not in keep:
                  os.environ.pop(name)
          seed_current_build_cache(cache, pin)
          PYSEED
      - name: Checkout exact retained public input source
        timeout-minutes: 1
        if: inputs.mode == 'build'
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # existing pinned checkout
        with:
          ref: 04a4a74e16e1e1bc939ea74791bf1f1bf7b46bbd
          path: retained-public-inputs
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Seed fourteen exact public ARM input files
        timeout-minutes: 2
        if: inputs.mode == 'build'
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git -C "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/retained-public-inputs" rev-parse HEAD)" = 04a4a74e16e1e1bc939ea74791bf1f1bf7b46bbd
          test "$(sha256sum retained-public-inputs/seed.py | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" = a7857658af224984065e575f6ffed8308ea85027d46eace8bda146d9033e93b3
          test "$(sha256sum retained-public-inputs/index.json | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" = a388c8c8ba8e06cb92fd2be598b86e433c4e403b6e71a0f15b1eaec381bb7300
          env -i PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin HOME="$HOME" LANG=C.UTF-8 TZ=UTC \
            TMPDIR="$RUNNER_TEMP" \
            python3 -I -B "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/retained-public-inputs/seed.py" \
              --cache "$RUNNER_TEMP/alarm-cache"
      - name: Transport exact complete574 retained DATA outside the closed source
        if: inputs.mode == 'build'
        timeout-minutes: 9
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          mkdir -m 700 "$RUNNER_TEMP/core622-retained-transport"
          set -o noclobber
          set +e
          timeout --signal=TERM --kill-after=30s 500s \
            python3 -I -B "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/core622-code/ownership622.py" --transport-complete574 \
            >"$RUNNER_TEMP/core622-retained-transport/phase.stdout" 2>"$RUNNER_TEMP/core622-retained-transport/phase.stderr"
          phase_exit=$?
          set -e
          printf '%s\n' "$phase_exit" >"$RUNNER_TEMP/core622-retained-transport/phase.exit-code"
          exit "$phase_exit"
      - name: Join all complete574 retained cache inputs before original acquisition
        if: inputs.mode == 'build'
        timeout-minutes: 5
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(sha256sum scripts/ci/native_arm.py | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" = a8b6ed8971a38089a4499dcec605477c4e48d7a47c3de485d205f6a44678b898
